title: Priority heuristics: One-off enterprise analytics requests vs productized reporting
creator: Ayesha Park
description: Context: We receive a steady stream of non-bug console/reporting requests from enterprise customers: ad-hoc usage exports, bespoke cost breakdowns, tenant-aligned dashboards, and scheduled ETL feeds. Many requests are one-off (high-touch, high-effort) while some repeat across multiple tenants and should be productized. Current intake lacks consistent signals to route requests to: (A) self-serve productization backlog, (B) low-touch scheduled export lane, (C) concierge engineering delivery, or (D) longer-term roadmap. This ticket defines priority heuristics, intake fields, SLAs, and routing rules to triage requests consistently and surface work that should be productized.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New intake form prototype captures required signals (data volume, cadence, format, sensitivity, requester role, business priority, blocking severity). 2) Heuristics matrix defined and documented: criteria for 'productize', 'scheduled-export', 'concierge', 'out-of-scope'. 3) Routing rules implemented in the intake workflow (tags + default assignee lanes). 4) Pilot run for 6 enterprise requests with clear outcomes (2 productization candidates, 2 scheduled exports, 2 concierge). 5) Telemetry added: funnel metrics (submitted -> routed -> delivered), estimated engineering hours, and customer satisfaction tags. 6) Confluence playbook and Triage SOP published.
proposal_summary: Implement a lightweight decision heuristic at intake: score requests across five dimensions (reusability, frequency, engineering complexity, data sensitivity, revenue/impact). Thresholds map to lanes: productize (score >= 8 and frequency >= monthly), scheduled-export (frequency >= weekly/monthly, low complexity), concierge (high complexity or sensitive data, high revenue), out-of-scope (low impact and high effort). Build a small UI/Forms change in the Console to capture signals and add a routing webhook to our Linear board. Create a short PRD + pilot plan and estimate 6 sprints of coordination for productization candidates.
risks_and_tradeoffs: - Risk: Over-automating routing could misclassify nuanced enterprise asks; mitigation: manual review window for first 30 pilot requests. - Tradeoff: Investing in productization requires upfront product dev vs delivering quick concierge wins; mitigation: require minimum customer-count or revenue threshold to recommend productization. - Telemetry cost: increased event volume for intake events; mitigation: sampled telemetry for low-impact requests.
